themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, or act as research assistants.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content discussing AI tools that help developers write, review, or debug code, often with a focus on specific models or use cases.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is being used by product managers for tasks like research, insights generation, and strategic planning.

themes.name: AI research platforms
themes.description: Discussions around platforms or tools designed to facilitate and enhance AI-driven research across various domains.

themes.name: Generative AI design
themes.description: Content related to AI's role in generating design assets, blurring lines between design and code, and automating creative processes.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles broadly covering the application of AI in enhancing both the design process and user research methodologies.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to analyze customer behavior, feedback, and market trends to derive actionable insights.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles detailing the use of AI for automating various aspects of software testing, including performance and validation.

themes.name: AI research tools broad
themes.description: Articles discussing a wide range of AI tools and their impact on research activities, without specifying a narrow application.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Content exploring how AI is changing job roles, requiring new skills, and affecting employment in various sectors.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
